verdict.rationale: No documented native bulk-edit or multi-select feature exists, but bulk work across many items is plausible through other routes. The REST API can create and manipulate content, the official MCP server and chat connectors let external agents act on the space, and the AI assistant can plan multi-step work and propose creates and updates for approval. That makes bulk operations an indirect, scripting- or agent-driven workaround rather than a stated capability. Missing for 10: explicit bulk/batch operations (multi-select edit, batch API endpoints), documentation of applying changes across many items at once, and hands-on corroboration.
